@Austrollian Besides PoW and PoS, here are some proven consensus protocols used in blockchain networks: - Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS): Used by EOS and Tron for faster, elected validation. - Proof of Authority (PoA): In VeChain and private Ethereum chains, relying on trusted identities. - Proof of Space and Time (PoST): Chia's eco-friendly approach using storage. - Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT): In Hyperledger Fabric for permissioned networks. - Proof of History (PoH): Solana combines it with PoS for high throughput. - Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAG): IOTA's Tangle for feeless, scalable transactions. These vary in scalability, security, and use cases.

VEN swapped to VET at 1:100, creating ~86.7B VET supply. The dual-token model involved: VET for staking, governance, value; VTHO for stable fees and a Proof-of-authority consensus with VET staked Authority nodes. The swap was completed in 2023 (99% done) via exchanges & wallets. Authority Masternodes needed staking & ID disclosure for trust . 2019-2023: Stability era! Partnerships with PwC, WallMart China & UFC fueled growth. VET hit its ATH in 2021. Holders earnt 0.000432 VTHO/VET daily with Economic & X-nodes offering extra rewards & voting rights . 2024: VeChain Renaissance Revealed! Revamped for Vechains sustainability mission as well as regulation, compliance, UX, compatability & developer ease : staking-linked VTHO to curb inflation , staking NFTs for bonuses , enhanced node roles, and much more. VeBetterDAO, a sustainability dApp ecosystem with $B3TR (incentives) & $VOT3 (gov) was also released. 2025: Galactica upgrade (July 1) refined tokenomics! Gas fee market with priority "tips" , stronger VTHO deflation , staking rewards up to 9.1% . 2026: Further integration of major tokenomics upgrades and main implementation of the Delegated Proof of Stake Delegator/Validator model.
